summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and Tuple[ControlType, str] in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the formatting entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and Control.title classmethod with docstring; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor (checks only is_terminal, returns bool, docstring notes Rich cannot restore the previous title); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md adds an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py (forced terminal, skipped on win32), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only, mocked wrapper). Tests were not run, per instructions; nothing was committed. Verification was by reading only, so Black formatting and mypy have not been checked.
